# Appeal of Denial – Total Shoulder Replacement (CPT 23472)

**RE: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated 2026-08-04**
**Member: Emerson Brooks | Member ID: W628799962**
**Reference Number: POC-9AB63CFCDF-18778**
**Governing Policy: Surgery of the Shoulder (2026T0556FF)** — https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/provider/docs/public/policies/comm-medical-drug/surgery-shoulder.pdf

Dear UnitedHealthcare Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472), which was denied on 2026-08-04 for "incomplete documentation." I am asking that this decision be reconsidered. My surgeon, Dr. Okafor, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and the records already submitted address the areas the denial says are missing.

## The policy names several different criteria sets, and I am not sure which one applies to my surgery

The policy states:

> "For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the:"

and

> "o Arthroscopy or Arthroscopically Assisted Surgery, Shoulder o Arthroscopy or Arthroscopically Assisted Surgery, Shoulder (Adolescent) o Joint Replacement, Shoulder o Removal and Replacement or Revision, Joint Replacement, Shoulder Click here to view the InterQual® criteria."

My request was for a **total shoulder replacement**, which appears to fall under "Joint Replacement, Shoulder." However, the specific criteria language cited in my denial refers to a "full-thickness massive rotator cuff tear measuring ≥ 5cm and involving ≥ 2 tendons," which describes rotator cuff repair, not joint replacement. I am asking the plan to confirm in writing which specific criteria set — Joint Replacement, Shoulder, or another listed set — was actually applied to my request, since the excerpt provided does not clearly match the procedure I am seeking.

## The policy confirms shoulder surgery is covered when medically necessary

The policy states:

> "Coverage Rationale Surgery of the shoulder is proven and medically necessary in certain circumstances."

My records show the circumstances my surgeon has documented:

- 18 months of progressive shoulder pain, unrelieved by rest.
- Supervised physical therapy for rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics, 12 weeks, 16 visits completed (2026-04-12 to 2026-07-05), documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- NSAIDs for 4 months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-29, giving only 2 weeks of partial relief.
- An MRI on 2026-06-29 showing a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- Inability to lift my arm above shoulder height or sleep on the affected side.
- A physical exam with positive provocative testing and range of motion limited by pain on the affected side.
- No active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, and I do not smoke.

## Where the record may need to be supplemented

If the "Joint Replacement, Shoulder" criteria — or the excerpted language above — is confirmed as the criteria applied, some specific data points referenced in that language do not appear to have been addressed in the documentation I have seen, including:

- My age: **[member's age or date of birth]**
- A VAS pain score: **[VAS score, if recorded]**
- A specific statement on functional deltoid muscle and preserved passive range of motion: **[surgeon's exam finding on deltoid function/passive ROM, if available]**

I am asking my surgeon's office to supply any of this information that exists in the chart, and I am asking the plan to identify specifically which of these items, if any, was the basis for calling the documentation "incomplete," since the notice does not say.

## Request for the specific criteria applied

The policy states that UnitedHealthcare uses InterQual® criteria to help administer benefits:

> "UnitedHealthcare may also use tools developed by third parties, such as the InterQual® criteria, to assist us in administering health benefits."

I understand InterQual is licensed software and not something I can look up on my own. Under my rights as a plan member (including ERISA and ACA appeal protections), I am asking the plan to provide, free of charge, the InterQual subset, edition, and full criteria text applied to my determination, so that I can understand exactly what was reviewed and respond to it directly.

## What I am asking for

I ask that UnitedHealthcare reconsider this denial in light of the documentation above, confirm which specific criteria set applies to CPT 23472, and provide the InterQual criteria language used in my review. I understand that providing documentation does not by itself guarantee coverage, but I believe the record supports a full and fair review of medical necessity.

My appeal is being submitted before the deadline of 2027-01-31 (180 days from the denial notice dated 2026-08-04). I am submitting this appeal by signing in at member.uhc.com and/or by calling the number on my member ID card, and I am using the appeal address printed on my denial letter as instructed.

Thank you for reviewing this appeal.

Sincerely,

**Emerson Brooks**
Member ID: W628799962
Date: **[date of signature]**
Contact phone: **[phone number]**
Contact email: **[email address]**

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
